facts.text: The hotel is on the bayside of Punta Pacifica in Panama City, near local businesses, shops and entertainment venues.
facts.excerpt: Situated on the bayside of Punta Pacifica, our Panama City luxury hotel boasts a convenient location near local businesses, shops and entertainment venues.

facts.text: The hotel has a resort-style infinity pool with views of the Panama City skyline.
facts.excerpt: Swim in our resort-style infinity pool and soak up stunning views of the Panama City skyline

facts.text: All rooms and suites have ocean views.
facts.excerpt: All rooms and suites at the hotel feature incredible ocean views that will take your breath away.

facts.text: Rooms and suites are pet-friendly, with decor inspired by the coastline.
facts.excerpt: recharge in a spacious, pet-friendly room or suite adorned with plush bedding and opulent decor inspired by the sparkling coastline

facts.text: Rooms have private balconies for watching the sunset.
facts.excerpt: Treat yourself to a bottle of champagne as you unwind on your private balcony and watch the sunset in our ocean-view hotel in Panama City.

facts.text: MASI is a restaurant with a live ceviche bar experience paired with local touches.
facts.excerpt: We offer a live ceviche bar experience paired with distinctive local touches.

facts.text: Azul is the hotel's poolside restaurant and bar with views of Panama City.
facts.excerpt: Soak up the sunshine and stunning views of Panama City at Azul Restaurant. With a tropical cocktail in one hand and a healthy meal in the other, transcend to an exotic getaway at our poolside bar and American restaurant in Panama City.

facts.text: Cava 15 is a wine bar and restaurant on the SL Floor with a wide wine selection and modern cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Wine bar and restaurant on the SL Floor with a wide wine selection and modern cuisine.

facts.text: The Executive Lounge includes breakfast, evening hors d'oeuvres, evening cocktails and desserts.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy an exclusive retreat that includes breakfast, evening hors d’oeuvres, evening cocktails & desserts.
Upgrade your trip in a luxury Panama City hotel suite with a plunge bath
Enjoy breakfast in bed in your Panama City, Panama accommodations with our 24-hour room service

facts.text: The hotel holds the Green Key international certification, an eco-label for tourism.
facts.excerpt: We are proud to have the Green Key international certification, one of the most recognized eco-labels worldwide in the tourism sector.

facts.text: The concierge staff can recommend gastronomic tours, historical sites and the city's museums.
facts.excerpt: the Concierge Staff of our luxury hotel in Punta Pacifica, Panama​ can assist you with the best recommendations for gastronomic tours, historical sites, and the city's must-see museums.

facts.text: The hotel has a children's pool.
The fitness center is a full-size gym.
The minimum age to check in is 18.

facts.excerpt: Wind down with authentic Panamanian cuisine at our brand-new restaurant, MASI.
